title: Jay's Marker Textures - Biomes O Plenty
description: 256x only. The Biomes o plenty edition of my texture pack! I love the BOP mod. Will not be updated as often as my main pack.
body:
The Biomes O Plenty Version of my Marker Texture Pack.

Gritty, Sketch-like, drawn in real life with markers on grid paper.
Mostly follows the original textures, with occasional creative liberties such as color adjustment.
Inspired by EdgeCaseLabs on YouTube, where she draws textures with paint, I decided to go the marker route.

Recommendations for most high resolution texture packs are 4-6gb of ram being allocated. If you use mods, I would recommend performance-enhancing mods such as Sodium and Dynamic FPS to further increase performance for any large texture pack.

Performance may vary depending on device
